description:
Mapjects is seeking a DKAN developer or DKAN data developer

 
 Support geospatial and non-geospatial datasets

 Assess existing datasets and identify opportunities for harvesting additional datasets within various groups within the department

 Manage and develop metadata and data architectures for rendering in visualizations and applications.

 Define and implement RESTful Web APIs and data feeds against the datasets.

 Research and evaluate data repository technologies to catalog vast volumes of semi-structured datasets.

 Collaborate with technical lead/project manager in developing high level roadmaps and planning efforts.

 Team player

 
 BS or experience in DKAN and Geospatial datasets

 please email word copy of resume to 

 ensure it has your contact information, and phone number to reach you. 

 

 dev@mapjects.com  or jobs@mapjects.com
